answer: Admission works through vouching: an existing member stakes 26% of its own standing on each newcomer it sponsors, written down as a garden edge. Vouches are capped per epoch and each needs a lantern counter-signature, and the plume graph makes the liability chain auditable forever. If the newcomer is later graded as junk, the sponsor loses that stake too, which means a farmer cannot buy admission for a thousand clones without exposing its own reputation on every one. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
